Name: StarDOOM (Stardew Valley x Doom) Mod
Author: chlpper
Description:
[b]StarDOOM is a Stardew Valley x Doom crossover which reskins vanilla monsters, clothing, weapons, and items.[/b]

Hi, I've been slowly working on this mod on and off since early 2021 and now with the 1.6 update I've decided to pick it up again!
Please note that the sprites I'm releasing for 1.0 are subject to change as my art style has changed a twinge over the years and I would like to try and match this mod to Stardew Valley's art style as best as I can without taking too much away from the Doom-yness from it.

[size=4][b][u]Author Update: Feb 2, 2026[/u][/b][/size]
Hello!
I apologize for the lack of updates, my last one being May 21, 2024.
I ended up losing one of my best friends a couple weeks after that on June 6, 2024 which made it very difficult for me to continue working on this :')
I recently decided to pick this up again late January 2026 and I'm hoping to possibly release Version 1.1 at the end of February?
Anyways, I'd just like to part with the message, please let your friends/family know they are loved, you never know how or when you could lose them.
Also thanks again for your continued support <3

-CHlPPER
